name: Ahiphena
how to use for vatta: Take with warm milk or ghee to calm dryness.
how to use for pitta: Take with ghee and sugar candy to reduce heat.
how to use for kapha: Take with honey to clear phlegm.

name: Agnimantha
how to use for vatta: Decoction with warm water and oil.
how to use for pitta: Use with ghee in mild dose.
how to use for kapha: Use with honey to reduce heaviness.

name: Agaru
how to use for vatta: Take with warm ghee or milk.
how to use for pitta: Use in small dose with milk.
how to use for kapha: Take with honey to stimulate lungs.

name: Amalaki
how to use for vatta: Take with warm water or ghee.
how to use for pitta: Take with cool water or ghee.
how to use for kapha: Take with honey to reduce Kapha.

name: Arjuna
how to use for pitta: Take with ghee or cool water.
how to use for kapha: Take with honey or warm water.

name: Ashwagandha
how to use for vatta: Take with warm milk and ghee.
how to use for kapha: Take with honey or warm water.
